channel.title: ETFIQ
channel.description: Independent data on buffer, option-income and thematic ETFs. What changed, and what the desks show, every trading night.

item.title: What changed, Sep 4, 2026
item.description: 87 of 245 buffer ETFs sit at their cap today. 13 buffer ETFs have their buffer absorbing losses right now. 42 buffer ETFs reset within 30 days; 12 reset in the last week and carry fresh caps. Over the last year, 24 of 154 index income ETFs finished ahead of their benchmark once cash was counted and reinvested. 56 income ETFs paid 10% or more in cash over the year while their price fell. 97 income ETFs pay out in the next seven days, 55 of them on dates the issuer has published.

item.title: The state of the buffer desk
item.description: On Sep 4, 2026, 87 of 245 buffer ETFs across 3 issuers sat at their cap, so in index terms those funds have no further upside this period.

item.title: Ahead or behind, and where the cash came from
item.description: Over the year to Sep 4, 2026, 24 of 154 index income ETFs finished ahead of the index they write options on, once every cash payment was counted and reinvested. The median fund was −5.6 pts against its benchmark.

item.title: How much of a theme is already the index
item.description: By their latest holdings filings, the typical thematic ETF has 32% of its weight in stocks the S&P 500 already holds, and 53 of 234 funds are more than sixty percent index names.
